heritage.heading: A LIVING SANCTUARY
heritage.description: Located steps from the historic San Pedro Market, our hotel offers an oasis of serene luxury. Every wall tells a story of Andean mysticism and human warmth, designed for you to rest before or after Machu Picchu.
heritage.fusionDesc: 500 years of history guarded within colonial archways and ancient stone.
heritage.patioAlt: Inca colonial patio of USGAR Hotels

gastronomy.description: An unforgettable culinary journey with fresh Andean ingredients in the historic heart of Cusco.

contact.title: Contact Us & Plan Your Trip
contact.subtitle: We would love to hear from you. Reach out to our bilingual team for direct reservations, private airport transfers, or travel advice.
contact.directionsTitle: How to Arrive in San Pedro
contact.directionsDesc: USGAR Hotels is located in the historic San Pedro neighborhood of Cusco. We provide private airport pickups to ensure a smooth and safe arrival.
contact.airportPickupDesc: Velasco Astete Airport is ~20 minutes away by car. We coordinate your private driver directly.
contact.whatsappQuery: Hello, I have an inquiry regarding my upcoming stay at USGAR Hotels.
contact.altitudeDesc: Cusco is at 3,400m altitude. We offer 24/7 complimentary oxygen concentrators and warm coca tea to ensure your comfort.
contact.receptionDesc: Continuous bilingual assistance for late check-in, complimentary luggage storage, and Machu Picchu excursion arrangements.
contact.faqLuggageQ: Can I store my luggage before check-in or after check-out?
contact.faqLuggageA: Yes! We offer 100% free, secure luggage storage while you explore Cusco or travel to Machu Picchu.
contact.faqOxygenQ: Is medical oxygen for altitude sickness included free of charge?
contact.faqOxygenA: Yes, complimentary oxygen concentrators and coca tea infusions are available for guests 24/7 at no extra cost.
contact.faqTransferQ: How do I arrange an airport pickup?
contact.faqTransferA: You can request it when submitting this form or select it during direct online room booking.
